analysis:
Examined all supplied additions, patches, metadata and telemetry documentation against the indexed model and selected T-041 detail. No independently supported security regression in this scope. AutopilotDownload.swift:93-114 gates catalog IDs/capabilities, checks a budget and delegates transfer verification; failures expose closed wire codes. Disk arithmetic fails closed on unknown capacity and overflow (43-46). AutopilotDownloadSettings.swift:19-36 defaults downloads on, subject to saved consent in callers not supplied here. AutopilotModelSet.swift:24-30 bounds the union; AutopilotStartInventory.swift:36-49,71-88 requires consent and verifies added cached builds against catalog hashes or offline ledger hashes. AutopilotDownloadLedger.swift:73-100 bounds normalized entries and atomically replaces an owner-only staging file. The ledger is operator-writable provenance, not independent attestation (A-004, T-012/T-027, TB-003). No key, inference-encryption, payment, fan-helper or prefix-cache crypto change is visible; T-041 controls are untouched. telemetry-schema.md:65-72 documents closed operational heartbeat diagnostics rather than client-event ingestion, but their producer is outside this batch.
Integration must verify consent/paused/download-disable and connection-lifecycle admission in ProviderLoop, cancellation of pending work, and serialization/reservation of budgets (TB-002, T-010/T-016/T-053). Download.swift:134-138 charges zero for a matching receipt: confirm downloader revalidation cannot cause an unbudgeted replacement. Budget usage excludes the target build; ledger loss/truncation drops accounting, so reconcile these cases with storage/model-cap callers. catalogAllows (AutopilotModelSet.swift:56-62) does not itself check engine family or load footprint despite refusal documentation; verify those checks before automatic transfer. Confirm offline ledger eligibility never substitutes for final serving/build authorization. These are unresolved cross-file contracts, not findings based on missing implementations.
